## Details

<a id="screen_ram"></a>
### [`screen_ram`](../../../../src/screen/screen_ram.asm#L6) `$4400-$444F`

*data*

Screen RAM of VIC bank 1: colours 1 and 2 of each bitmap cell, 25 rows of 40 bytes. The colours of the part 1 arena differ from part 2. $917f writes the text colours. $8e20 exchanges rows 7-22, columns 4-35 with $e11c at a scene change.

- **Referred to by:** [`swap_centre_colours`](scene.md#swap_centre_colours)
- **Entry of:** [`screen_row_addr`](../../tables.md#screen_row_addr)
